text:
```yaml
name: Claude Code

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue_number:
        description: 'Issue Number'
        required: true
        type: string
      instructions:
        description: 'Optional Instructions'
        required: false
        type: string

jobs:
  claudie-code:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Verify collaborator status
        id: verify_collaborator
        run: |
          curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" https://api.github.com/user/repos?collaborators=true | grep -q '200'
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Run Claude Code
        if: steps.verify_collaborator.outputs.http_code == 200
        id: run_claudie_code
        run: npx anthropics/claude-code-action@v1 --issue_number ${{ github.event.inputs.issue_number }} --instructions ${{ github.event.inputs.instructions }} --anthropic_api_key ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
        env:
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}

      - name: Create Pull Request
        if: steps.run_claudie_code.outcome == 'success' && steps.verify_collaborator.outputs.http_code == 200
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v7
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          branch: claudie-code-${{ github.event.inputs.issue_number }}
          title: "Claude Code Fixes for Issue #${{ github.event.inputs.issue_number }}"
          body: "Automatically generated PR based on Claude Code suggestions."
          labels: "claude-code"
          reviewers: "your-maintainer-username"
          assignees: "your-maintainer-username"
          draft: true
```
